_provenance: Synthetic HTTP-200 GET /2/tweets?ids=111,222 batch lookup where `includes` is present but partial, the DRIFT-1/REND-5 shape a real platform response can take when an author or referenced tweet has been suspended/deleted since the tweet was indexed. Post 111 attaches a media key with no matching `includes.media` entry (an unknown/unsupported media type from the platform's point of view); post 222's author_id (99) has no matching `includes.users` entry, and its reply_to id (444) has no matching `includes.tweets` entry either. Exercises: REND-5 per-field degrade (author falls back to the raw numeric id, the unresolvable reply_to keeps its id and omits author, the unmatched media item is dropped) at the tool-integration boundary (mock HTTP -> x_post_get handler -> compaction), never a crash, never a dropped item. Authored 2026-09-24.
